links.comparator_used: Same LLMs without RAG (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Hallucinations in static tasks and performance in dynamic multi-turn clinical workflows
links.effect: RAG mitigates hallucinations in static tasks; efficacy in dynamic workflows is limited and heterogeneous, sometimes causing degradation (no numbers given in the abstract)
links.tradeoff: In dynamic workflows RAG sometimes degraded performance; external knowledge alone could not bridge the reasoning gap without domain-adaptive pre-training
links.quote: While RAG mitigates hallucinations in static tasks, its efficacy in dynamic workflows is limited and heterogeneous, sometimes causing degradation.
